description: Out-of-domain questions: the vLLM corpus cannot answer them. 'far' = unrelated topics; 'near' = related vocabulary (other ML/serving tools) but not about vLLM. Used to measure how often the system correctly answers 'not found'. Checked against the corpus: 'What is the capital of France?' was removed because the vLLM docs use it (with its answer) as an API example.
